name: c-message-scroller-1
title: Chat transcript with jump to latest
label: Jump to Latest
description: A scroll region that opens at the live edge with a jump to latest control.

guidance.bestFor: A read only 9 message thread on the provider defaults, with no client state, streaming or composer to strip out
agentNotes: Replace `TURNS` with your thread and `VIEWER_AVATAR`, an Unsplash photo, with the signed in user's picture
Change the `aria-label` on `MessageScrollerViewport` for each surface; without one the region is announced as Messages

name: c-message-scroller-2
title: Streaming reply that follows the edge
label: Streaming Reply
description: autoScroll pins the viewport while tokens arrive, and releases the moment the reader scrolls up.

guidance.bestFor: A reply typed out 4 characters every 28ms under a Working badge, with aria-busy on the log and a Replay stream button
agentNotes: Swap the `setTimeout` loop that slices `REPLY` for your stream, appending chunks to the row whose id is `REPLY_ID`
Keep `aria-busy` on `MessageScrollerContent` while a reply streams, so the log announces the finished row once instead of per chunk

whenNotToUse.when: A settled thread where no reply is being written

name: c-message-scroller-3
title: Anchored turn with a previous peek
label: Anchored Turn
description: scrollAnchor lifts a sent message near the top while a slice of the previous turn stays visible.

guidance.bestFor: A composer form that sends questions and gets a canned answer after 900ms, each question lifted near the top under a 64px peek
agentNotes: Replace the 900ms `setTimeout` in `handleSubmit`, which answers from `REPLIES`, with your send and reply call
The `scrollPreviousItemPeek` gap is left above a row only when it carries `scrollAnchor`, so keep that prop on the question rows

whenNotToUse.when: A reply that grows token by token while the view follows the bottom

name: c-message-scroller-4
title: Opening position for a saved thread
label: Opening Position
description: Compare start, end and last-anchor as the place a reopened thread opens at.

guidance.bestFor: A Tabs switch over the 3 opening positions on a thread whose last answer outgrows the panel, with a day divider on top
agentNotes: Pick one `defaultScrollPosition` and drop the `Tabs` switch; the provider re-applies the position every time the value changes
`last-anchor` falls back to the end when no row has `scrollAnchor` or everything from the last anchored row down already fits the viewport

whenNotToUse.when: Stepping between the questions of a long thread after it has opened

name: c-message-scroller-5
title: Load earlier without losing your place
label: Load Earlier
description: Older turns prepend above the reader while the row they were reading stays put.

guidance.bestFor: A header Load earlier button adding 5 older turns per click to a 6 of 16 window, with a badge that reports whether the view can scroll up
agentNotes: Replace `loadEarlier`, a 700ms timer that widens the `HISTORY` slice, with a cursor fetch that prepends older rows
Keep the load control outside `MessageScrollerContent`; a permanent first row never moves, so the prepend restore never fires
Key rows by a stable `id`, never the index; with index keys the old first row never moves and the prepend restore silently skips

name: c-message-scroller-6
title: Thread navigator for stepping turns
label: Thread Navigator
description: A footer navigator that reports the turn you are reading and jumps between turns.

guidance.bestFor: Previous and next buttons around a turn counter and the current question, tracked from the anchor and jumped with smooth scrolling
agentNotes: `currentAnchorId` only names rows that carry both `messageId` and `scrollAnchor`, so build `QUESTIONS` from those same rows
`scrollToMessage` reaches only rows given a `messageId`; a divider or any row without one cannot be a jump target

whenNotToUse.when: Choosing where a reopened thread lands before anyone scrolls
